title: Delhi Homebuyers To Benefit As DDA Includes Parking In Flat Price | What It Means | New-delhi-news News - News18
text: Homebuyers in Delhi have reason to cheer. The Delhi Development Authority has scrapped the requirement for separate parking payments, deciding instead to include parking construction costs in the overall price of flats. Here’s what the revised rule means for buyers and upcoming housing schemes. The Delhi Development Authority (DDA) has revised its pricing policy. From now on, the cost of constructing parking facilities will be included in the total price of the flat. This means the long-standing practice of making a separate payment for parking has been discontinued. Buyers will no longer face the additional step or confusion of paying parking charges separately. Earlier, parking charges were calculated and collected separately. Under the revised system, the total cost of developing housing pockets will include the parking construction cost. If the engineering wing does not provide a separate cost breakdown, the parking construction cost will be treated as 60% of the Plinth Area Rate (PAR). The revised policy will apply to all existing and upcoming DDA housing schemes, including: Allottees under these schemes will see the revised pricing structure reflected in the total flat cost. While the overall flat price may appear slightly different due to the inclusion of parking construction costs, certain policies remain unchanged: Although the total flat price may increase marginally, buyers will benefit from a simpler and more transparent payment structure. There will be no separate billing or additional payment process for parking, making property transactions smoother and clearer.
